timings.notes: Checked official Tauri, pnpm, and Playwright docs, then inspected package scripts and Tauri config.
Split setup/verify/package scripts, added prepared renderer hook, and updated checks/tests/docs.
Ran setup, quick verify, full verify, and internal package build.
Recorded web search, plan, trace, evaluation, omission, resource, and timing notes.

bottleneck_notes: The old setup:verify path forced dependency setup and full verification together.
The old internal package path could rebuild the Next.js renderer during Tauri build after the verify path already built it.
The new prepared renderer hook keeps the customer bundle audit while avoiding duplicate Next.js build work during package.
